messages.subject: Error in data.frame(evaled, PANEL = data$PANEL) :    arguments imply differing number of rows: 35550, 269549
parts:
Okay, so I have read a ton of posts about this. Here is what I have so
far:


sd = df_range[with(df_range, order(df_range[["Emp_Dens"]])),]
qplot(x=sd[["X_Cent"]], y=sd[["Y_Cent"]], data=sd,
colour=sd[["Emp_Dens"]])

> length(df_range)
[1] 35550
> length(sd)
[1] 35550
> length(sd$X_Cent)
[1] 35550
> length(sd$Y_Cent)
[1] 35550
> length(sd$Emp_Dens)
[1] 35550
>

running this:

qplot(x=sd[["X_Cent"]], y=sd[["Y_Cent"]], data=sd,
colour=sd[["Emp_Dens"]])
Using OBJECTID to define regions.
I get this error:

Error in data.frame(evaled, PANEL = data$PANEL) :
arguments imply differing number of rows: 35550, 269549

using this:
qplot(x=sd[["X_Cent"]], y=sd[["Y_Cent"]], colour=sd[["Emp_Dens"]])
I get no errors at all. df_range is a subset of a removed data frame,
sd is ordered df_range. I removed the OBJECTID part of sd and added an
ID which was just 1:nrows(sd) and I still get the same error. Why when
I add data does it really seem to want to be 269549 rows when the true
number of rows is 35550. To me this makes no sense.
